Boil water with heat, then turn the steam into FE in a Steam Turbine Array. It beats the Thermoelectric Plant once you run it hot.
# Grades
- Steam: from 100°C. 10 HU per mB.
- High-Pressure Steam: from 500°C. 15 HU per mB.
- Superheated Steam: from 900°C. 20 HU per mB.
Better grades cost more heat but give a turbine much more FE per mB.
Steam is a gas: it travels in Pressurized Conduits and is stored in Pressurized Cylinders, never in fluid tanks or pipes.
